title: Mixed Event — Secret Operation Valentine's Day — Episode8 Happy Valentine's Day!

meta.Event Outline: With Valentine's Day just on the horizon, Airi is planning a surprise for everyone to show them her gratitude. She happens to meet Saki and Emu, who both had similar ideas, and they form a Secret Valentine's Day Alliance.

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ready, everyone?
Feast your eyes on this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
Wow!! It's a giant cake!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not only is it big, but it's also so detailed...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
It's both beautiful and adorable at the same time...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It really is!
I've never seen anything like this in a store before!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-And this is supposed to be a stage, right? With us on top of it!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, Minori, let's settle down.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But...
It's almost too good to be true! Right, you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: An edible stage is such a lovely idea!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A stage where everyone's having fun while dancing no less♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, this is so cool!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure you could surprise anyone this much even on stage...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Looks like you've even gotten the best of KAITO with this one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did you bake this yourself, Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, of course I did!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I mean, it's Valentine's Day, right?
You all deserve to have some extra-special sweets today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I even spent a whole day making this, so I hope you all really enjoy it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But this cake's so amazing that I kinda wish our fans could be here to enjoy it too!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Unfortunately, that'll have to wait until another time. This one's just for you guys, including you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
I promise to savor every bite!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, it's a magnificent cake♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Certain things are expected from idols when it comes to giving gifts, but this passes with flying colors.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you, Airi.
I've never experienced such a wonderful Valentine's Day before.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such an incredible person, Airi. I still can't believe you actually baked this♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? You say that, but I get this feeling that you're not as surprised as you say you are...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Did you know that I was gonna do something like this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, of course not!
I'm truly, genuinely surprised!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm still not buying it, but anyway...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's one last thing. Surprise!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One last thing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh? You made something else for us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's right!
I made you guys...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: These!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
They're dolls of us!
I don't believe it!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
These are incredible!
And they look just like us♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
The costumes are really well made too.
They could come to life at any second.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you guys like them so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But wait, Airi, I don't remember seeing anything like this when I went to visit you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
These were top secret.
It was all a part of my plan to have everyone on this Valentine's Day stage♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So let's start putting them up there.
Starting with... Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Look, I'm on stage now too♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And Miku and Len and Luka and MEIKO and KAITO... Hehe. Our stage is buzzing with excitement now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like we're all doing a show together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for including us as a part of your surprise, Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, it looks like we're having a blast.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'd like to thank you for including me as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What a lovely scene...
It's a dream performance that's bound to make everybody smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm hoping that we can pull off something like this in real life someday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's no way it wouldn't be fun if we're all together like this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly! Doing all this wasn't easy, but I'm glad our Valentine's Day turned out as well as it did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You did a wonderful job, Airi.
Thank you for giving us such a lovely Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I mean, only someone like you could put smiles on everyone's faces like this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you talking about? This is nothing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm an idol, aren't I?
I did this because you all mean so much to me!
